description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales,

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 1 Hawthorne Drive, an outstanding six-bedroom family residence occupying a magnificent seafront position in one of the most exclusive areas of Renmore.

Overlooking Ballyloughane Beach, Galway Bay and the Burren beyond, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinctive home in one of Galway’s most cherished neighbourhoods. Fully extended and remodelled in 2007, the residence now extends to 234 square metres, offering oceans of living space, generously proportioned bedrooms and exceptional coastal views.

Surrounded by open green spaces, the property enjoys a wonderful sense of calm and an outlook of outstanding natural beauty, all within walking distance of the city centre.

On arrival, an upgraded entrance doorway opens into the substantial extended porch, where an oversized window makes the most of the stunning views across the bay. To your left, the first reception room enjoys further sea views and a feature fireplace, creating an inviting space in which to relax and unwind. 

This leads through to the fully remodelled kitchen, dining and living area, a spacious heart to the home. The upgraded kitchen features premium Corian countertops, built-in appliances and a generous breakfast area, while two oversized Velux windows flood the dining space with natural light. A further reception room, currently used as a home office, offers excellent flexibility and would make an ideal playroom for families with young children.

To the rear, an exceptionally spacious utility room provides extensive built-in storage together with additional loft storage. It opens onto the fully enclosed back garden, where a flagstone patio, mature planting and a large steel garage complete the outdoor space.

Four of the home’s six bedrooms are located on the ground floor. The original master bedroom offers generous floor space, built-in wardrobes and an outlook over the rear garden. Two further well-appointed double bedrooms, an additional single bedroom and the family bathroom complete the accommodation on this level.

Upstairs, the benefits of the substantial extension and remodelled roof become particularly apparent. A large Velux window illuminates an expansive landing that feels like a room in its own right.

The principal bedroom is outstanding, with an exceptionally generous floor area and a striking apex window framing breathtaking views of Galway Bay. There is abundant room for storage, while the unusually spacious en suite is larger than many family bathrooms and features a Velux window, additional storage and a Jacuzzi bath with separate shower area.

On the opposite side of the house, the sixth bedroom is equally impressive and is currently arranged as a cinema room. Featuring built-in surround sound, a large en suite and matching  apex window overlooking the rear patio providing  this is a wonderfully versatile space.

With its extensive upgrades and B energy rating, No. 1 Hawthorne Drive combines the character of an established family home with the space and comfort of a thoroughly remodelled residence.

If you are searching for a marquee property that brings together space, luxury, location and outstanding views of Galway Bay, No. 1 Hawthorne Drive is certain to impress.

If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and show you around.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales.
